description: The most powerful solar flare ever recorded! This mega-blast from the Sun was so strong that it went off the scale of our measuring instruments.
The strongest solar flare in over a decade! This powerful explosion sent a burst of energy racing toward Earth at nearly the speed of light.
Just days after another huge flare, the Sun blasted out another powerful X-class flare from the same active sunspot region. Double trouble!
Part of the famous Halloween Solar Storms! This enormous flare knocked out some satellites and created beautiful auroras visible all the way to Florida.
A giant bubble of magnetized gas erupted from the Sun and headed straight for Earth! It traveled at over 2,000 km per second — super fast even for space weather.
The biggest solar flare of Solar Cycle 25! This powerful flare caused radio blackouts across the sunlit side of Earth for about an hour.
The biggest flare of Solar Cycle 24! Sunspot region 1263 unleashed this powerful blast of X-ray energy into space.
This powerful flare came with a huge burst of fast-moving protons — the strongest solar radiation storm in 50 years! Astronauts had to take shelter.
A massive wave of energetic protons zoomed through space at nearly the speed of light! These particles can be dangerous for astronauts without proper shielding.
This strong X-class flare erupted from a big sunspot group. It caused a brief radio blackout on the side of Earth facing the Sun.
This CME was a near-miss monster! If it had hit Earth, it could have caused trillions of dollars in damage to our power grids and electronics.
A New Year's Eve surprise from the Sun! This X5-class flare rang in the new year with a spectacular blast of energy.
An impressive flare from early 2024! The Sun was getting very active as it approached solar maximum — the peak of its 11-year cycle.
An M-class flare that was almost an X-class! M-class flares are medium-sized but can still cause minor radio blackouts near Earth's poles.
Multiple CMEs slammed into Earth's magnetic field, creating the strongest geomagnetic storm in 20 years and amazing auroras visible worldwide!
A moderate M-class flare that kicked off a wild week of solar activity. More powerful flares followed just days later!
A small C-class flare. These happen all the time and are like tiny pops compared to the mighty X-class flares. Most are harmless!
Fast-moving charged particles from the big May 2024 solar storms reached Earth. Airline pilots flying over the poles received extra radiation warnings.
